title: Find the problem point
text: The integrand is undefined at $$x=-1$$, which is inside the interval from $$-2$$ to $$2$$. Split the integral at $$x=-1$$.

title: Check one piece
text: The integral from $$t$$ to $$2$$ is $$\frac{-1}{3}+\frac{1}{1+t}$$. As $$t$$ approaches $$-1$$ from the right, this goes to $$\infty$$, so the whole integral diverges.
